overall: GOOD north and east today; south still windy
limiterDetail: Main limiter: wind in the south (ENE, sustained per ECMWF). Nangalao stays at 15.6–18.2 kt all day (peak ~9–11 PM), Cabunlawan and Decabaitot at 14–17.3 kt (peaks ~8 AM and ~10 PM). Ciron is 13–15.3 kt until ~2 PM, then eases to ~10 kt through the evening. The north stays under 8.6 kt all 24h. Rain is light; the next burst is Sun ~3–5 AM in the south. Currents are mild (0.1–0.8 kt now).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR of gale, tropical cyclone wind signal and heavy-rain alerts for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The MIMAROPA flood advisory has ended: GFA #4 (Final), Region 4-B (MIMAROPA) , Sat 5:10 AM PHT (after GFA #3, Fri 4:41 PM). That fits ECMWF's light rain today.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Next week turned softer, so shortage risk is up from MILD to ELEVATED. ECMWF dropped Mon 19 from GOOD to MARGINAL on rain (~10.6 mm, was ~7.1; wind only 3 kt) and dropped Thu 22 from the week's best day to MARGINAL (10 kt, gusts 13, was 3.3 kt). Wed 21, Thu 22 and Fri 23 are now all MARGINAL , so expect thinner deliveries from about Thu 22 into Sat 24.

Unchanged and good: today (Sat 17) is still GOOD/HIGH (8.6 kt, gusts 16, ~5 mm) and the stock refill still starts this evening. The north is calmer than forecast: Coron, Culion and Galoc are GOOD at 4.1 kt. PAGASA closed the MIMAROPA flood advisory (GFA #4 Final, 5:10 AM).

bestWindow.headline: ~3 PM–Sun 5 AM (Coron, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay) · all day (Decabobo)
details: ~3 PM–Sun 5 AM: Coron, Culion and Galoc drop to 1.4–4.3 kt, currents 0.1–0.4 kt, and no rain ~6 PM–midnight. Maglalambay is near-calm (under 4 kt) from ~noon with 0.1–0.3 kt current; its best hour per the model is ~6 PM. This morning is also workable in the north (4–8.6 kt) apart from light showers ~9 AM–noon.
Decabobo, all day: 1.2–6.6 kt wind and 0.0–0.4 kt current. Turda has the same wind but its current runs 0.8–1.0 kt ~6 PM–2 AM, so go early (best ~7 AM). Tara's current is 0.5 kt or more all 24h.
Keep boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot today (14–18.2 kt, gusts ~21), and off Ciron until ~2 PM (13–15.3 kt). Ciron's best hour is ~5 PM (9.6 kt).
